product_title: Traditional Peacock Shubh Labh Hanging Pair with Pearl Embellishments and Golden Accents
product_description: Enhance your festive home decor with this beautifully designed Peacock Shubh Labh Hanging Pair. Featuring vibrant multicolored peacock motifs, intricate golden detailing, elegant pearl borders, and auspicious Shubh Labh lettering, these decorative hangings bring traditional charm and festive elegance to your home. The circular golden design, delicate pearl tassels, and colorful peacock feathers create a stunning combination of artistry and cultural beauty. Perfect for decorating main doors, pooja rooms, temple entrances, walls, and festive spaces, this decorative pair is ideal for Diwali, weddings, housewarming ceremonies, and other auspicious occasions. Add a touch of traditional elegance and vibrant color to your celebrations with these beautiful decorative hangings.
product_care_suggestion: Clean gently with a soft, dry cloth to remove dust.
Avoid washing or exposing the product to water to protect the decorative materials, pearls, and golden detailing.
Keep away from direct sunlight for extended periods to preserve the vibrant colors of the peacock motifs.
Handle the pearl tassels carefully to prevent tangling, stretching, or breakage.
Avoid harsh chemicals, detergents, and abrasive cleaning materials.
Store in a cool, dry place inside a soft cloth bag or protective box when not in use.
Keep away from sharp objects to prevent scratches or damage to the decorative motifs.
Hang securely using the attached loops and avoid pulling the decorative elements.
